journey: A reader adds the published @three-ws/three-token-mcp server to their AI client, the client lists three_burn marked irreversible, a call without confirm: true is refused, and a confirmed call takes the real burn path against live $THREE config and pricing on Solana. The trial runs the published npm package over stdio exactly as a client would. It never burns: the confirmed call uses a fresh, empty throwaway wallet, so it stops at the balance check before any transaction is built or signed.

steps.name: the published server lists three_burn as irreversible, refuses without confirm: true, and a confirmed burn runs the live $THREE path up to the wallet balance check
three_burn refuses to sign without confirm: true, and the confirm gate runs before the burn cap (repo tests)
three_burn carries destructiveHint and the two reads are read-only (repo tests)
the package is published on npm
the linked MCP Tool Catalog page shows three_burn as Irreversible
